description: Frontend heartbeat status timeline on the detail page: types, API client, the HeartbeatTimeline.svelte component (modeled on StatusTimeline.svelte but convention-compliant), detail-page integration, mandatory empty state, and i18n keys across all 13 locales. Depends on FEAT-002 (the endpoint contract). Scope is the heartbeat detail page only; no live WS append in v1 (on-load fetch + retry).
steps: In frontend/src/lib/types.ts add history_retention_days: number to the Heartbeat interface (around line 175) and add: export type HeartbeatEventType = 'success' | 'fail' | 'missed'; export interface HeartbeatEvent { event_type: HeartbeatEventType; previous_state?: 'up' | 'down' | 'paused' | 'new'; occurred_at: string }; export interface HeartbeatHistorySummary { uptime_percent: number | null; missed_count: number; fail_count: number; success_count: number; total_events: number }; export interface HeartbeatHistoryResponse { heartbeat_id: string; from: string; to: string; truncated: boolean; summary: HeartbeatHistorySummary; events: HeartbeatEvent[] }. Also add history_retention_days to the CreateHeartbeatRequest shape in api.ts (around line 887).

In frontend/src/lib/api.ts add export async function getHeartbeatHistory(id: string, from: string, to: string): Promise<HeartbeatHistoryResponse> using the existing apiRequest<T> helper: const params = new URLSearchParams({ from, to }); return apiRequest<HeartbeatHistoryResponse>('GET', `/heartbeats/${id}/history?${params.toString()}`). Intentionally omit step (v1 renders raw events).

Create frontend/src/components/HeartbeatTimeline.svelte modeled on StatusTimeline.svelte's layout and interaction (color-coded horizontal bar + legend + summary + click-to-expand failure popover) but adapted for discrete heartbeat events. Props: { events: HeartbeatEvent[]; summary: HeartbeatHistorySummary; loading: boolean; error: string | null; from: string; to: string }. Map event_type to color: success->healthy, fail->down, missed->a distinct missed-run color. Bucket when events exceed a maxMarkers threshold (e.g. 120) where a bucket's color is the WORST event in it with ordering missed > fail > success (problems never hidden); below the threshold render one marker per event. fail/missed markers (or buckets) open a popover listing events with occurred_at and type; success markers are non-interactive. Summary row shows summary.uptime_percent (em dash when null; color thresholds >=99 healthy, >=95 warn, else down) and summary.missed_count, plus a legend that always lists all three states. MUST use CSS custom properties / brand utilities from app.css for status colors (never hardcoded Tailwind palette classes like bg-emerald-500), [data-theme="dark"] for any dark-mode variance (never the dark: prefix), and route EVERY user-visible string through t('...').

Render the mandatory empty state inside HeartbeatTimeline.svelte when summary.total_events === 0 and not loading/error: a bordered panel using t('heartbeats.timeline.empty') and t('heartbeats.timeline.emptyHint'). Loading and error states mirror the detail page's existing loading/error panels and use t() keys. (No virtualization in v1 — bounded rendering via bucketing + capped popover list.)

In frontend/src/routes/heartbeats/[id]/+page.svelte add state let history = $state<HeartbeatHistoryResponse | null>(null), historyLoading, historyError; in fetchData() (or a sibling effect keyed on heartbeatId) call getHeartbeatHistory(heartbeatId, from24hAgo, now) and populate them; render <HeartbeatTimeline events={history?.events ?? []} summary={history?.summary ?? ...} loading={historyLoading} error={historyError} from=.. to=.. /> inside a card titled t('heartbeats.timeline.title') placed BETWEEN the Overview fields card and the <PingExamples> block.

Add a timeline block under the existing heartbeats object in frontend/src/locales/en.json FIRST with keys: title ('Status Timeline (24h)'), uptime, uptimeTooltip, missed, legendSuccess, legendMissed, legendFail, loading, loadFailed, empty, emptyHint, eventSuccessAt ('Success at {time}'), eventMissedAt ('Missed run at {time}'), eventFailAt ('Explicit failure at {time}'). Then replicate the SAME keys (English values as placeholders) into every other locale: ar, be, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh. Keys must be byte-identical across locales.

Add frontend/src/components/HeartbeatTimeline.test.ts (Vitest + @testing-library/svelte, following existing *.test.ts patterns) covering: empty state at zero events; success/missed/fail marker rendering; bucketing above threshold picks the worst-state color; popover lists failures; and that all visible text comes from t() (no literal strings leak).
acceptance_criteria: `cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm check` passes (TypeScript strict, Svelte checks).
`cd frontend && pnpm validate-locales` passes; the timeline keys additionally exist in ar.json and be.json (verified manually because validate-locales omits them).
`cd frontend && pnpm test` passes, including the new HeartbeatTimeline tests (empty state, marker rendering, worst-state bucketing, popover, no literal-string leak).
`cd frontend && pnpm build` succeeds and the detail page renders the timeline card between the Overview card and PingExamples with a mandatory empty state when there are no events.
HeartbeatTimeline.svelte uses only CSS custom properties / brand utilities (no hardcoded palette classes), [data-theme="dark"] (no dark: prefix), and t() for every visible string.
verification: cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm check
findings:
FEAT-003 complete. Frontend heartbeat status timeline shipped on the detail page.

TYPES (frontend/src/lib/types.ts): added history_retention_days: number to the Heartbeat interface, and new exports HeartbeatEventType ('success'|'fail'|'missed'), HeartbeatEvent (event_type, optional previous_state, occurred_at), HeartbeatHistorySummary (uptime_percent number|null, missed_count, fail_count, success_count, total_events), HeartbeatHistoryResponse (heartbeat_id, from, to, truncated, summary, events[]). Shapes match FEAT-002's documented JSON exactly (previous_state optional because the backend uses omitempty; uptime_percent nullable).

API (frontend/src/lib/api.ts): added getHeartbeatHistory(id, from, to) => GET /heartbeats/{id}/history?from=&to= via the existing apiRequest<T> helper (step intentionally omitted; v1 renders raw events). Added history_retention_days?: number to CreateHeartbeatRequest (UpdateHeartbeatRequest aliases it). Imported HeartbeatHistoryResponse.

COMPONENT (frontend/src/components/HeartbeatTimeline.svelte): new, modeled on StatusTimeline.svelte's layout/interaction (color-coded horizontal bar + legend + summary + click-to-expand popover) but convention-compliant. Props { events, summary, loading, error, from, to, maxMarkers=120 }. event_type -> color: success=bg-success, missed=bg-warning (distinct missed-run color), fail=bg-error. Below maxMarkers renders one marker per event; above it buckets into equal time slices over [from,to] where a bucket's state is the WORST event (severity missed>fail>success) so problems are never hidden; empty slices are skipped. fail/missed markers open a popover listing problem events via t() labels (capped at 5 with a +N overflow); success markers are non-interactive. Summary row shows uptime_percent (em dash when null; thresholds >=99 text-success, >=95 text-warning, else text-error) and missed_count, plus a 3-state legend always visible. Esc/outside-click close the popover.

EMPTY/LOADING/ERROR STATES (in-component, data-testid hb-timeline-empty/loading/error): mandatory empty state when summary.total_events===0 and not loading/error uses t('heartbeats.timeline.empty') + emptyHint in a bordered panel; loading uses t('heartbeats.timeline.loading'); error renders the passed error message. Error takes precedence over empty.

CONVENTION COMPLIANCE (verified by grep): no hardcoded Tailwind palette classes (bg-emerald/rose/amber/slate/indigo/red/green/...), no dark: prefix. Only semantic/brand utilities backed by app.css CSS custom properties (bg-success/warning/error, text-success/warning/error, text-primary/secondary, bg-surface/page, border-border, ring-brand-400); dark-mode variance comes free from [data-theme="dark"] overriding those vars. EVERY user-visible string routes through t('...').

DETAIL-PAGE INTEGRATION (frontend/src/routes/heartbeats/[id]/+page.svelte): added state history/historyLoading/historyError/historyFrom/historyTo and an EMPTY_SUMMARY fallback. New fetchHistory() computes a last-24h window (to=now, from=now-24h as ISO strings) and calls getHeartbeatHistory; invoked from the existing heartbeatId $effect alongside fetchData() inside untrack. Rendered <HeartbeatTimeline .../> inside a card titled t('heartbeats.timeline.title') placed BETWEEN the Overview fields card and the <PingExamples> block, as specified.

I18N (frontend/src/locales): added the heartbeats.timeline block to en.json FIRST (title, uptime, uptimeTooltip, missed, legendSuccess, legendMissed, legendFail, loading, loadFailed, empty, emptyHint, eventSuccessAt '{time}', eventMissedAt '{time}', eventFailAt '{time}' = 14 keys) plus common.close ('Close') for the popover close aria-label. Replicated the SAME 14 timeline keys and common.close into all 12 other locales (ar, be, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh) using English placeholders via a one-off generator script (removed after use); key sets are byte-identical across all 13 locales (verified). The {time} interpolation placeholder matches the i18n interpolate() {var} syntax. MANUAL ar/be CHECK: confirmed heartbeats.timeline (14 keys) and common.close present in ar.json and be.json (validate-locales omits those two).

TEST (frontend/src/components/HeartbeatTimeline.test.ts, Vitest + @testing-library/svelte): covers mandatory empty state at zero events; loading and error states; one-marker-per-event rendering with correct state colors below threshold; dense bucketing above maxMarkers picks the worst-state color (missed wins over success/fail); explicit missed>fail>success ordering; popover opens and lists failures for a fail marker; success markers do not open a popover; summary shows uptime/missed/legend via t() and computes 50.0% for 2/4 success; em dash for null uptime; and a no-literal-leak assertion that 'heartbeats.timeline.' never appears in the DOM (would only appear if a t() key failed to resolve).

PRE-EXISTING FIXTURE FIX: making history_retention_days a required field on Heartbeat broke two existing heartbeat test fixtures; added history_retention_days to frontend/src/lib/stores/heartbeats.test.ts (makeHeartbeat default 30) and frontend/src/lib/stores/heartbeats.property.test.ts (arbHeartbeat fc.integer 1..365). No production behavior change.

VERIFICATION RESULTS (all from frontend/): pnpm install OK. pnpm check -> 0 errors (57 pre-existing warnings in unrelated files: NotificationChannelForm/HeartbeatForm state_referenced_locally). pnpm validate-locales -> all 693 keys present in every locale, PASSED. pnpm test -> 562 passed / 51 files (includes the new HeartbeatTimeline suite). pnpm build -> built OK, static adapter wrote build/. Manual ar/be key check: PASSED.

NOTE FOR FINAL REVIEW: v1 is on-load fetch + no live WS append (per design 5.6); the detail page has no explicit timeline retry button beyond re-mount, matching design (optional WS re-fetch is deferred). The timeline window is fixed at last-24h (no range picker in v1). common.close was added as a shared key (not in the task's literal timeline key list) because the popover needs a generic close aria-label and that is the convention-correct home for it; it is replicated across all 13 locales too.
